BTC.note: Binance hack: an exchange breach, not Bitcoin itself; 95% covered, withdrawals reopened
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3bn on 29-30 Oct; the FBI says North Korea did it. It was not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says 95% is now replenished (BTC fully backed) and reopened withdrawals in phases on 1 Nov, starting with Bitcoin; a verifiable reserves proof is expected around 2-3 Nov. The attacker's 18,270 stolen BTC still hasn't moved, though they are swapping stolen SOL into BTC; watch for any selling. Separately, Bitcoin Core fixed medium-severity node-crash bugs (e.g. CVE-2026-117350); no funds at risk. Quantum: new estimates remain theoretical, hardware expected late 2020s to early 2030s.

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. Intel's Israel factory explosion is an operations issue, not a security one.
